documented_probe: Documented probe waiver: C-8034934c (fix cython source for numpy 2.x api compatibility) reference floor is medium; this task exercises the capability directly at medium in a single-package scope rather than the multi-component repair of basalt-mantle.
notes: Focused medium: port a vendored Cython extension off numpy 2.x-removed interfaces. Dependent stages: fix build configuration -> fix stale C API / removed numpy.math usages in the .pyx -> build against installed numpy 2.x -> regular install -> probe report (build must precede probe). Requires tool breadth (Cython/setuptools/pip) and reasoning about which legacy interfaces were removed (numpy.distutils, numpy.math, PyArray_FromDims). Hidden cases generalize hann/ramp to unseen n including empty ramp(0), n==1 window, larger n, and ValueError paths, and check genuine float64 ndarray returns. Quantitative correctness checked to 1e-9. Offline; verifier re-runs the build deliverable twice for idempotency.
